import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,5))
ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,6); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
ax.set_title('Remote-operation mast layout side view')
ax.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((2,1.5),5,1.0, fill=False, linewidth=2))
ax.text(4.5,2.0,'chassis', ha='center')
ax.add_patch(mpatches.Circle((2.8,1.2),0.6, fill=False, linewidth=2))
ax.add_patch(mpatches.Circle((6.2,1.2),0.6, fill=False, linewidth=2))
ax.text(2.8,0.3,'wheel', ha='center'); ax.text(6.2,0.3,'wheel', ha='center')
ax.add_patch(mpatches.Circle((1.5,1.5),0.5, fill=False, linewidth=2))
ax.text(1.5,0.6,'bucket drum', ha='center')
ax.plot([3.5,4.0,6.0,6.5],[2.5,3.2,3.2,2.5],'k-', lw=2)
ax.text(5.0,3.4,'hopper', ha='center')
ax.plot([6.5,6.5],[2.5,5.2],'k-', lw=2)
ax.text(6.9,3.8,'mast')
ax.plot([5.9,7.1],[5.2,5.2],'k-', lw=2)
ax.add_patch(mpatches.Circle((6.1,5.2),0.15, fill=False))
ax.add_patch(mpatches.Circle((6.9,5.2),0.15, fill=False))
ax.text(6.5,5.6,'dual FPV cameras', ha='center')
ax.text(6.5,4.8,'depth + IMU + LED', ha='center')
ax.plot([6.1,0.8],[5.1,1.5],'k--', lw=1)
ax.plot([6.9,7.8],[5.1,1.5],'k--', lw=1)
ax.text(8.2,1.8,'view to bin', ha='center')
ax.text(0.5,2.5,'view to dig face', ha='center')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png', dpi=150)
